name: Pan-Fried Zucchini Fritters with Creamy Cucumber Tzatziki Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
½ lemon
¼ small bunch fresh dill
½ English cucumber

instructions.primary_message: Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Transfer to a colander and sprinkle with salt. Place the colander in a bowl to catch the excess moisture and set aside to drain.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a small bowl. Add yogurt and spices, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the yogurt mixture.
Trim and coarsely grate cucumber. Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated cucumber. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the tzatziki, and set aside.
Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated zucchini, then transfer to a medium bowl. Add eggs, flour, baking powder, and spices, then stir to combine the batter.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp baking powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
1 pinch nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches, using a ¼-cup measure, drop batter into the skillet, spacing scoops a few inches apart; press down to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until fritters are golden brown, 4-6 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Divide fritters between plates and serve with tzatziki for dipping. Enjoy!
